selected_evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage
selected_evidence.summary: The repository index matches the package checksum; the enabled service listens on port 8080 and returns the index through node1's managed IP.

selected_evidence.requirement: Install a package while normal remote repositories are unavailable
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu and ESM sources were preserved outside active APT paths. APT refreshed exclusively from 10.100.33.10, fetched version 1.0.0 from that repository, installed it, and executed its payload successfully.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic were unchanged before installation and after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID 17b8f2fe-787d-486e-bd47-a11aad4a2595 was captured, restart acknowledgement returned, and the new boot ID 691161ec-fdad-4da8-920c-d05208a5e65c proved the restart. Afterwards the system was running, the repository service and HTTP artifacts recovered, checksums matched, APT refreshed only locally, and the installed package remained functional.
